title: What If the Sun Turned Into a Black Hole?

scenes.text: What if the Sun became a black hole? Earth wouldn't be pulled in. It would keep orbiting.
A black hole with the Sun's mass pulls on Earth exactly as much as the Sun does now.
So the orbit stays. Year after year, the planets keep circling the same point.
The difference is light. Sunlight takes about eight minutes to arrive, so the sky would stay bright for that long.
Then the Sun's glow stops. The solar system would get very dark and cold.
The Sun can't become a black hole by itself, because it's too light. But the gravity part is real.

description:
What if the Sun turned into a black hole?
Earth would keep its orbit, but the lights would go out.
What should we run through next?
